description: P-Video 2 driven by your voice-over or music: an MP3 or WAV up to 20 seconds, a prompt and an optional starting image make a 720p video exactly as long as the audio, with the audio kept. Compared with other video tools: budget. Price: from $0.034 per second (one call: from $0.170 per video), charged only on success. Price depends on max_seconds: 5 $0.170, 10 $0.339, 15 $0.508, 20 $0.676 (default 5). With an account API key you pay only for what the call used (per second), never more than this price. One call = one short video.

audio.description: Your voice-over or music as an MP3 or WAV link; the video is exactly as long as this audio and keeps it as its soundtrack. Or send the file inline as a base64 data: URI (up to 4.5 MB)

image.description: Optional starting image (https URL). Or send the file inline as a base64 data: URI (up to 4.5 MB)

max_seconds.description: Longest the audio can be; sets the price. Longer audio is refused before anything runs, and not charged. Default 5

name: video-p-video-2-voice
title: P-Video 2 from your own audio
